question: Is exact-head registry parity proof, including direct sibling Codex contract inspection, sufficient to land this broad internal decomposition?
rationale: The structure matches the requested owner boundaries, but the protected label and movement of authorization- and runtime-sensitive plugin paths require a human owner to accept the final proof breadth.

options.title: Require exact-head parity proof
options.body: Rebase, complete the direct Codex source check, and require all focused registry, boundary, build, and exact-head CI gates before merge.

options.title: Accept existing Testbox proof
options.body: Treat the supplied 302-test, changed-check, build, and autoreview evidence as sufficient once ordinary required CI finishes.

recommendation.title: Require exact-head parity proof
recommendation.body: Rebase, complete the direct Codex source check, and require all focused registry, boundary, build, and exact-head CI gates before merge.

likelyOwner.reason: They have the strongest recent merged history across this registry and its adjacent runtime surfaces.
